steps.headline: 2 Al(s) + Fe2O3(s) -> Al2O3(s) + 2 Fe(s) releases 850.4 kJ per mole as written and goes forward on its own at 298 K (dG = -838.9 kJ, K = 10^147). Left to keep its own heat it reaches 3139 K, where boiling or melting holds it.
